dl.dt: Why can't I select a budget line on an acquisition?
dl.dd: Only budget lines belonging to an Approved budget version are selectable. Ask Finance to approve the budget version first.
A real vendor price must be confirmed first via "Confirm Real Price" — the confirmed amount, not the original estimate, is what gets reserved.
dl.dt: My acquisition says "Insufficient Funds" - what now?
dl.dd: Choose a different budget line, split the amount across several budget lines, request an internal budget transfer, or request supplementary donor funding - all from the acquisition's own form.
dl.dt: Why can't I approve a donor supplementary funding request?
dl.dd: Recording the donor's approval requires both an "Amount Confirmed" and the donor's bank receipt attached (via the chatter paperclip) first.
dl.dt: Who can approve an internal budget transfer?
dl.dd: Only a Finance Manager. The transfer never changes either line's original Planned amount - the effect shows separately as Transferred In / Transferred Out.
dl.dt: What's the difference between an Advance and a Liquidation?
dl.dd: An Advance is cash sent to a zone or employee, who becomes a debtor. A Liquidation reports and clears that advance with justified, posted expenses.
dl.dt: I rejected/cancelled something by mistake - is there a record of why?
dl.dd: Yes - every Reject, Cancel, and Reset to Draft action requires a typed justification, which is posted directly to that record's own chatter as well as the audit log.
